name: Marry Me, Jaehee!
source:
A fangame based on Cheritz's wonderful mobile game, Mystic Messenger. After Jaehee's business proposal, the two of you have started running a cafe together, but it's time you made a proposal of your own...!

Marry Me, Jaehee! was created by fans for everyone who loved Jaehee Kang's route, but wished for a longer (and unambiguously romantic) ending.

[From [url=https://jlmkart.itch.io/marry-me-jaehee]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款基于Cheritz精彩手机游戏《神秘信使》的同人游戏。在Jaehee提出商业建议后，你们两个开始一起经营一家咖啡馆，但现在是你提出自己的建议的时候了……！

嫁给我吧，杰熙！是由粉丝为所有喜欢Jaehee Kang的路线，但希望有一个更长（并且明确浪漫）结局的人创建的。

[来自[url=https://jlmkart.itch.io/marry-me-jaehee]itch.io[/url]]
